props.name: online
props.description: Override the browser's own reading — useful when your API is the thing that is down.

props.name: queued
props.description: Changes waiting to be sent. Shown even once the connection returns.

props.name: retryIn
props.description: Seconds until the next automatic attempt. Counts down locally.

props.name: retrying
props.description: A reconnection attempt is in flight.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Called when the retry action is pressed.

props.name: restoredFor
props.description: Milliseconds to keep "back online" on screen before it goes.

props.name: fixed
props.description: Pin to the top of the viewport rather than sitting in the flow.
